1.mascotDialogue: The pivot does not move again after partitioning — it is already home. Everything left to sort is strictly smaller on one side, strictly larger on the other.

2.mascotDialogue: Line 9 places the pivot at its final resting index. Lines 16 and 17 recurse on the strictly-smaller and strictly-larger sides — the pivot itself is never touched again.

3.mascotDialogue: This pivot happened to be the smallest value, and so it ends at index 0 — an unfortunate choice of pivot, and a fine example of why selection matters for performance.

4.mascotDialogue: One character out of place — p instead of p minus 1 — and the recursion loses its most important guarantee: that each recursive call works on a strictly smaller range than the one before.
